name: PT Trimitra Propertindo Tbk
summary: PT Trimitra Propertindo Tbk engages in the real estate business in Indonesia. The company is involved in construction, development, and sale of apartment and small office home projects. It also develops kiosks units for apartments, as well as operates and manages hotels. PT Trimitra Propertindo Tbk was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia.
